"""Generate the fixed-instance two-can packing trajectory."""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_robolab import Session

OUT = Path('/app/output')

def move(s, xyz, quat, speed=.18, **kwargs):
    result = s.primitives()['move_ee'](xyz, quat, speed=speed, **kwargs)
    print('MOVE', xyz, 'error', result, 'tcp', s.ee_pose()[0], flush=True)

def grasp(s, name, z, yaw=0.):
    p = s.primitives()
    quat = p['top_down_quat'](yaw)
    xyz = s.objects()[name]['position']
    x, y = xyz[:2]
    p['open_gripper']()
    move(s, [x,y,.30], quat)
    move(s, [x,y,z], quat, speed=.08, tol=.002, settle=5)
    p['close_gripper'](25)
    print('GRASP', name, s.objects()[name], s.proprio(), flush=True)
    move(s, [x,y,.33], quat, speed=.10, settle=5)
    print('LIFT', name, s.objects()[name], flush=True)
    return quat

def place(s, name, xy, quat, z=.13):
    p = s.primitives()
    move(s, [*xy,.33], quat, speed=.15)
    move(s, [*xy,z], quat, speed=.08, settle=5)
    p['open_gripper'](20)
    move(s, [*xy,.34], quat, speed=.1)
    p['hold'](15)
    print('PLACE', name, s.objects()[name], s.status(), flush=True)

def run(s):
    s.record_start()
    quat = grasp(s, 'tomato_soup_can', .043)
    place(s, 'tomato_soup_can', [.70,.38], quat)
    quat = grasp(s, 'tuna_can', .004)
    place(s, 'tuna_can', [.49,.40], quat, z=.11)
    actions = s.record_stop()
    s.save_trajectory(actions, str(OUT/'trajectory.npz'))
    print('FINAL', s.status(), 'actions', actions.shape, flush=True)
    return actions

if __name__ == '__main__':
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    session = Session('food_packing2_cans', instance='/app/instance.json')
    run(session)
